P.text: A gHYBR holder calls GovernanceHYBR.withdraw with all their shares (full exit), and the computed remainingAmount (or feeAmount) is zero.
P.evidence_quote: User calls `GovernanceHYBR.withdraw` with all their shares

I.text: VotingEscrow.multiSplit requires every split weight to be strictly positive.
I.evidence_quote: `VotingEscrow.multiSplit` enforces every split weight to be strictly positive

V.text: The contract forwards [remainingAmount, userAmount, feeAmount] with a zero element and multiSplit reverts with "ZW", so the withdrawal fails and the user cannot exit their position.
V.evidence_quote: the contract forwards `[remainingAmount, userAmount, feeAmount]` with a zero element and reverts with `"ZW"`
